newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp to invest A$18 mln in China.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp to invest A$18 mln in China.

text.p: Australian wine and packaging group Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it would invest A$18 million in a joint venture with the Dalian Crown Making Factory to build a can making plant in the northern Chinese port city of Dalian.

"Southcorp Packaging will contribute 85 percent of the equity with the Dalian Crown Making Factory, an established supplier of closures to the beverage industry in the region, contributing the balance," Southcorp said.
"The contract...involves the manufacture and sale of three piece steel cans and aluminium beverage cans," it said.

Southcorp Packaging general manager Barry Watts said the decision to invest in China added to the group's other packaging ventures in Asia, including a rapidly growing PET (polyethelyne threphthalate) plastic bottle joint venture in Malaysia.
"The project will strengthen Southcorp Packaging's foothold in one of the fastest growing consumer markets," Watts said.
The joint venture will trade under the name Southcorp Can (Dalian) Company Ltd.
Southcorp opened a plant to manufacture water heaters in the Chinese city of Chengdu in the central province of Sichuan in September. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
